Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?

Yes, damaged items are handled differently from a standard return. If an item arrived damaged, I can help review it as a quality issue rather than having you start a normal return. In most cases, I’ll need your order number or checkout email, and a clear photo of the damage. If it’s an odor issue, photos usually aren’t needed. 🖤
